sloka: वर्षेण एव आगतम् विप्रम् तापसम् स नराधिपः ।प्रति उद्गम्य मुनिम् प्रह्वः शिरसा च महीम् गतः ॥१-१०-३०॥
transliteration: varṣeṇa eva āgatam vipram tāpasam sa narādhipaḥ ।prati udgamya munim prahvaḥ śirasā ca mahīm gataḥ ॥1-10-30॥

translations.english: He gave that Indra among the brahmins offerings righteously with unstinted devotion and asked for his favour that he should not incur the wrath of the sage (his father Vibhandaka for having brought him to Anga).
